##### Random Network FFRCISTG

The random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (RNFFRCISTG) is a causal model defined by i) no contagion and ii) interference only through the random network, which restrict the graph; iii) homogeneous random network interference with respect to the included random graphs and iv) identical structural distributions, which are statistical assumptions; and single-world independence with each graph generator taken as a single variable (@def-rnffrcitg).
